[[Tab]] cambia il tipo del paragrafo: Sc: [[Tab]] changes the paragraph type: Scene → Action → Character → Parenthetical → Dialogue → Transition ([[Shift+Tab]] goes back); hold it to choose from the list. The symbols at the start of the line stay in the file but are not shown.
